---
title: "Correlation Analysis: TWIST1 vs OVOL1 in GSE294844"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(limma)

# 1. Load Data
gse <- getGEO("GSE294844", destdir = ".", getGPL = TRUE)[[1]]
exprs_mat <- exprs(gse)
metadata <- pData(gse)

# 2. Extract Normal vs Dysplastic from the Title
# We look for "normal" or "NS" vs "dysplastic" or "AK" in the title string
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(Condition = case_when(
    grepl("normal|NS", title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "NS",
    grepl("dysplastic|AK|lesion", title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "AK",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("NS", "AK")))

# Re-download with a focus on the platform (GPL)
gse <- getGEO("GSE294844", destdir = ".", getGPL = TRUE, AnnotGPL = TRUE)[[1]]
feature_data <- fData(gse)
colnames(feature_data) # Check again

# 1. Get the feature data
feature_data <- fData(gse)

# 2. Find the column that looks like it contains Gene Symbols
# We'll look for "SYMBOL", "Gene Symbol", or "Gene.Symbol"
potential_cols <- grep("SYMBOL|Gene.Symbol|Gene Symbol", colnames(feature_data), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)

if(length(potential_cols) == 0) {
  stop("Could not find a Symbol column. Check colnames(fData(gse)) manually.")
}

# Pick the first match
target_col <- potential_cols[1]
message("Using column: ", target_col, " for Gene Symbols")

# 3. Perform the mapping using standard base-R indexing for the rename
probe_mapping <- feature_data %>%
  # We use .data[[target_col]] to safely handle the dynamic string
  mutate(Symbol = .data[[target_col]]) %>%
  select(ID, Symbol) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Symbol) & Symbol != "") %>%
  # Clean up Affymetrix multi-gene strings
  mutate(Symbol = gsub(" ///.*", "", Symbol))

# 4. Proceed with filtering your markers
target_genes <- c("TWIST1", "OVOL1", "KLF4", "IVL", "LOR", "KRT1", "KRT10", "MYC")
selected_probes <- probe_mapping %>% filter(Symbol %in% target_genes)

# Now extract and average
clean_exprs <- exprs_mat[as.character(selected_probes$ID), ]
rownames(clean_exprs) <- selected_probes$Symbol
clean_exprs_unique <- avereps(clean_exprs, ID = rownames(clean_exprs))
```
